# ankra_service_consumers (Data Source)

Lists one application's consumer bindings, the namespaces managed services may be set up for. Bindings on clusters the token cannot read are not listed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_service_consumers" "orders" {
  application_id = "3c2b1a0f-9e8d-4c7b-a6f5-e4d3c2b1a0f9"
}

output "orders_namespaces" {
  value = [for consumer in data.ankra_service_consumers.orders.consumers : consumer.namespace]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Application whose bindings to list.

### Read-Only

- `consumers` (Attributes List) Consumer bindings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--consumers))
- `id` (String) The application id.

<a id="nestedatt--consumers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `consumers`

Read-Only:

- `allow_planned` (Boolean) Whether the binding was made before the application was installed.
- `application_id` (String) Application.
- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster of the namespace.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the binding (the consumer id).
- `local_only` (Boolean) Whether only services on the same cluster may be used.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace.
- `revision` (Number) Revision of the binding.
- `updated_at` (String) When the binding last changed.
